meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing (so `npx claude-mem@X.Y.Z` resolves) is handed off to the human maintainer, who raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动管理版本号并生成发布流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发布前都要手动改版本号和写更新日志
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps and release workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually update version numbers and changelogs before every release

howto.what: 当你要求发布新版本时，Claude 会自动分析变更类型，更新所有相关配置文件中的版本号，执行构建验证，提交并推送代码和标签，创建 GitHub Release，生成更新日志并推送，发送 Discord 通知，最后把 npm 发布这一步交给你手动完成。
howto.when: 当你说“发布新版本”“升级版本号”等类似要求时触发。

say.text: 帮我发布一个 patch 版本。
升级到 1.2.0，然后创建 GitHub Release。
say.note: 更新版本、构建、推送并创建 Release，并生成更新日志。

say.text: 按 minor 类型发个新版本，记得更新 changelog。
say.note: 它会更新版本、生成日志并推送，最后通知你手动发布 npm。

howto.what_en: When you ask to release a new version, Claude analyzes change type, updates version strings in all config files, runs build-and-sync, commits/pushes code and tags, creates GitHub release, regenerates changelog, sends Discord notification, and hands off npm publishing to you.
howto.when_en: When you request a new release or version bump.

say_en.note: Claude runs the full release flow and reminds you to publish to npm.

say_en.text: Bump to 1.2.0 and create the GitHub release.
say_en.note: It updates versions, builds, pushes, and creates the release.

say_en.text: Release a minor version and update the changelog.
say_en.note: It updates the version, generates the changelog, and pushes.
